column1: # KarryGo platform service register. One row per deployable service.
# Every script in deploy/platform/bin and the deploy-platform workflow read this
# file, so a service is added or changed in exactly one place.
# Columns (separated by "|", spaces around values are ignored):
#   key         the service folder name under services/ and the GHCR image name
#   dockerfile  "shared" = services/Dockerfile, otherwise a path from the repo root
#   home        folder under /opt/karrygo on the server (settings + release files)
#   container   the main container's name (others in the compose file follow it)
#   port        the port the program listens on inside the container (HTTP_ADDR)
#   env_file    the private settings file inside the home folder
#   migrate     how tables are prepared on deploy:
#                 builtin = the service applies them itself at startup (its *_MIGRATION flag)
#                 script  = deploy runs migrate.sh inside the new image first
#   db_url_var  for migrate=script: the setting holding the database address
# key                             | dockerfile                               | home                      | container                         | port | env_file         | migrate | db_url_var

api-gateway                       | shared                                   | api-gateway               | karrygo-api-gateway               | 8080 | gateway.env      | script  | API_GATEWAY_DATABASE_URL
media-file-service                | shared                                   | media-file-service        | karrygo-media-file-service        | 8109 | media.env        | builtin | -
notification-service              | services/notification-service/Dockerfile | notification-service      | karrygo-notification-service      | 8106 | notification.service.env | builtin | -

customer-service                  | shared                                   | customer-service          | karrygo-customer-service          | 8101 | customer.env     | builtin | -
